## Role in the Rating Process

The European Investment Fund has no direct role in the minimal rating process or the discretionary adjustments process. It does not provide data for the [Growth](../parameters/growth.qmd), [Inflation Differential](../parameters/inflation-differential.qmd), [Fiscal Capacity](../parameters/fiscal-capacity.qmd), Safe Rate, [Refinancing Need](../parameters/refinancing-need.qmd), or [Backstop Eligibility](../parameters/backstop-eligibility.qmd) parameters.
